description: Fork of exp257 (TinyMHLut(soft) + noise eps=0.002 -> 1.6060). Replace TinyMultiHeadLut(backward_mode='soft') with MultiHeadLut(smooth_mode=False, n_alternatives=3) + same bernoulli noise on small deltas (argmax_noise_eps=0.002). Tests whether the noise-as-regularization recipe generalizes from the soft-pipeline backward to the standard MultiHeadLut STE/WTA path. If ~1.60 -> noise injection is the universal lever, soft bwd adds nothing on top; if near exp234 (1.6212) -> soft bwd is the genuine substrate.
